exercises.title: Future Forms — Recupera
exercises.description: Scegli tra will, be going to e Present Continuous dal significato: decisione immediata/previsione, piano-intenzione/evidenza, accordo già organizzato.
exercises.instructions: Prima chiediti che tipo di futuro stai comunicando; poi costruisci la forma corretta.

sections.title: Il futuro cambia con l'intenzione
sections.instructions: Non scegliere dalla parola tomorrow: leggi cosa è già deciso, organizzato o appena deciso.

questions.title: Will, going to o Present Continuous?
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Collega ogni forma a una decisione comunicativa precisa.
questions.learning_objective: Choose and form will, be going to and Present Continuous future forms from communicative meaning.

content.body: In inglese non esiste una sola forma per parlare del futuro. Will è utile per decisioni prese mentre parli e per previsioni/opinioni; be going to per piani già decisi e previsioni basate su evidenza; il Present Continuous per accordi futuri già organizzati.
content.intro: La domanda non è «che parola di tempo vedo?», ma «questa decisione nasce adesso, era già un piano, oppure è già un appuntamento organizzato?». Per le previsioni: è un'opinione o vedo un'evidenza concreta?

sections.title: Will: decisione presa adesso
sections.body: Se decidi cosa fare nel momento in cui parli, will è la forma naturale.

examples.text: The phone's ringing. I'll answer it.
We're out of milk. I'll get some on my way home.

sections.title: Will: previsione o opinione
sections.body: Per una previsione basata soprattutto su ciò che pensi, senza una prova visibile immediata, puoi usare will.

examples.text: I think our team will win.
I don't think the test will be difficult.

sections.title: Going to: piano o intenzione già decisa
sections.body: Se avevi già deciso il piano prima di parlare, usa be going to.

examples.text: I've decided to save money. I'm going to cook at home more often.
Sara is going to study design next year.

sections.title: Going to: previsione con evidenza
sections.body: Se vedi una situazione presente che rende il risultato futuro molto probabile, usa be going to.

examples.text: Look at those black clouds. It's going to rain.
That glass is at the edge of the table. It's going to fall.

sections.title: Present Continuous: accordo già organizzato
sections.body: Se c'è un accordo concreto — per esempio persona, ora, luogo o prenotazione — usa spesso il Present Continuous con un riferimento futuro chiaro.

examples.text: I'm meeting Luca at six tomorrow.
We're seeing the dentist on Friday morning.

sections.title: Intenzione o appuntamento?
sections.body: Un'intenzione può esistere senza dettagli fissati. Un arrangement è già organizzato.

correct.text: I'm going to see Marta this weekend. · I'm meeting Marta at 11 outside the station on Saturday.
highlight: at 11 outside the station on Saturday

sections.title: Controlla la struttura
sections.body: Dopo aver scelto il significato, controlla la forma.
sections.pattern: will + base verb · am/is/are going to + base verb · am/is/are + verb-ing

examples.text: She's calling you at eight tonight.

sections.title: La scelta in cinque domande
points: Piano già deciso? → be going to.
Previsione basata su evidenza presente? → be going to.
Accordo futuro già organizzato? → Present Continuous.

questions.title: La decisione nasce adesso
questions.prompt: A: Someone's at the door. B: Don't worry, ___.
questions.instructions: Scegli la risposta naturale.
questions.learning_objective: Choose will for an instant decision made at the moment of speaking.

options.text: I'll get it
I'm going to get it next week
I'm getting it every day

feedback.explanation: La decisione viene presa mentre B parla: I'll get it.

questions.title: Vedi l'evidenza
questions.prompt: The sky is very dark and you can hear thunder. What do you say?
questions.instructions: Scegli la previsione più naturale.
questions.learning_objective: Choose be going to for a prediction based on present evidence.

options.text: It's going to rain.
I think it will rain one day.
It is rain tomorrow.

feedback.explanation: Il cielo scuro e il tuono sono evidenza presente: It's going to rain.

questions.title: Piano deciso o appuntamento fissato?
questions.prompt: Completa le due situazioni.
questions.instructions: Leggi quanto è organizzato il piano.
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish a prior intention from a fixed future arrangement.

content.text_template: 1. I've decided to learn to drive. I [[blank_1]] lessons soon. 2. My first lesson is booked for Monday at 5. I [[blank_2]] the instructor outside the driving school.

feedback.explanation: Start lessons = piano/intenzione; Monday at 5 + booking = arrangement concreto.

questions.title: Will non prende to
questions.prompt: Correggi: I'll to call you after class.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb directly after will.

accepted_answers: I will call you after class.

feedback.explanation: Will + base verb: will call, non will to call.

questions.title: Un arrangement concreto
questions.prompt: Domani alle sei incontro Sara davanti alla stazione.
questions.instructions: Traduci come accordo futuro già organizzato.
questions.learning_objective: Produce Present Continuous for a fixed future arrangement with time and place.

accepted_answers: I'm meeting Sara in front of the station at six tomorrow.
I am meeting Sara in front of the station at six tomorrow.
I'm meeting Sara outside the station at six tomorrow.
I am meeting Sara outside the station at six tomorrow.
Tomorrow at six, I'm meeting Sara in front of the station.
Tomorrow at six, I am meeting Sara in front of the station.

feedback.explanation: Ora e luogo sono già fissati: I'm meeting Sara...

exercises.title: Future Forms — Allenati
exercises.description: Pratica will, going to e Present Continuous in decisioni, previsioni, piani e accordi reali.
exercises.instructions: Non guardare solo l'espressione di tempo: chiediti cosa era già deciso e quanto è organizzato.

sections.title: Usa l'intenzione comunicativa
sections.instructions: Le tre forme sono mescolate: devi riconoscere il significato prima della struttura.

questions.title: Una decisione al volo
questions.prompt: Scegli la risposta più naturale.
questions.instructions: Leggi il dialogo completo.
questions.learning_objective: Use will naturally for an instant decision in dialogue.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I know. I don't want to walk home like this.

options.text: I'll give you mine. I'm getting the bus anyway.
I'm going to give you mine yesterday.
I'm giving you mine every Friday.

feedback.explanation: Nina decide di dare l'ombrello in risposta al problema appena emerso: I'll give you mine.

questions.title: Opinione o evidenza?
questions.prompt: Completa le due previsioni.
questions.instructions: Distingui una previsione-opinione da una previsione basata su ciò che vedi.
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish will predictions from evidence-based going-to predictions.

content.text_template: 1. I think our new teacher [[blank_1]] very good. 2. Watch that cyclist! He [[blank_2]] into the puddle.

options: is going to be because I can see him fall

answer_error_mappings.answer: is going to be because I can see him fall

feedback.explanation: I think = opinione/previsione; Watch that cyclist = evidenza presente immediata.

questions.title: Un weekend con tre tipi di futuro
questions.prompt: Completa il mini-testo con la forma indicata dal contesto.
questions.instructions: Scrivi la forma completa del verbo tra parentesi.
questions.learning_objective: Produce will, going to and Present Continuous future forms in one connected context.

content.text_template: I've decided to get fitter, so I [[blank_1]] (start) swimming. My first session is booked: I [[blank_2]] (meet) the coach at the pool at 9 on Saturday. Oh, I forgot to buy goggles — I [[blank_3]] (get) some after class.

feedback.explanation: Decisione precedente → going to; booking + ora/luogo → Present Continuous; decisione nata ora → will.

questions.title: Manca be
questions.prompt: Correggi: She going to apply for the course next month.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Use the correct form of be before going to.

accepted_answers: She's going to apply for the course next month.
She is going to apply for the course next month.

feedback.explanation: Be going to contiene sempre una forma di be: she is going to apply.

questions.title: Un arrangement in domanda
questions.prompt: Metti le parti nell'ordine corretto.
questions.instructions: Chiedi dell'appuntamento già organizzato per domani.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Present Continuous question about a fixed future arrangement.

feedback.explanation: What time are you meeting the tutor tomorrow?

questions.title: Un piano già deciso
questions.prompt: Ho già deciso: l'anno prossimo studierò informatica.
questions.instructions: Traduci usando be going to per il piano/intenzione.
questions.learning_objective: Produce be going to for a prior decision or intention.

accepted_answers: I've already decided: I'm going to study computer science next year.
I have already decided: I am going to study computer science next year.
I've decided: I'm going to study computer science next year.
I have decided: I am going to study computer science next year.
I've already decided: I'm going to study IT next year.
I have already decided: I am going to study IT next year.

feedback.explanation: La decisione esiste già prima di parlare: I'm going to study...

questions.title: Quali frasi corrispondono al contesto?
questions.prompt: Marta has booked a table for 8 pm on Friday. Seleziona tutte le frasi che possono descrivere correttamente l'arrangement o un commento sul futuro.
questions.instructions: Valuta significato e forma.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a fixed arrangement and a separate will prediction while rejecting form errors.

options.text: Marta is having dinner at the new restaurant at 8 on Friday.
I think she'll enjoy it.
Marta going to having dinner at 8.
I think she will to enjoy it.

feedback.explanation: Prenotazione + ora → arrangement; I think → will prediction. Going to richiede be + base verb; will prende il verbo base senza to.

questions.title: Intenzione o arrangement?
questions.prompt: Completa le due frasi sullo stesso progetto.
questions.instructions: La prima è un'intenzione generale; la seconda è già fissata in calendario.
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish a prior intention from a scheduled personal arrangement.

content.text_template: We [[blank_1]] a new website this year. On Tuesday at 10, we [[blank_2]] the designer to discuss the first version.

feedback.explanation: Build = piano già deciso; Tuesday at 10 + designer = arrangement concreto.

exercises.title: Future Forms — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica will, going to e Present Continuous in formati tipici di verifica, con feedback solo alla fine.
exercises.instructions: Completa tutto prima di vedere correzioni e spiegazioni.

questions.title: Complete the text
questions.prompt: Put the verbs into the most appropriate future form.
questions.instructions: Usa will, be going to o Present Continuous secondo il contesto.
questions.learning_objective: Produce all three core future forms accurately in a connected school-style text.

content.text_template: I've decided to improve my English, so I [[blank_1]] (join) a conversation course. The first class is booked: I [[blank_2]] (meet) the teacher at 6 on Monday. I think the course [[blank_3]] (help) me a lot. Oh, I haven't told Giulia — I [[blank_4]] (message) her now.

feedback.explanation: Prior decision → going to; booking → Present Continuous; opinion → will; decision now → will.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: We are going meet them after lunch.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase corretta con be going to.
questions.learning_objective: Correct missing to in a be-going-to structure while retaining the base verb.

accepted_answers: We are going to meet them after lunch.
We're going to meet them after lunch.

feedback.explanation: Be going to + base verb: are going to meet.

questions.title: Choose the best form
questions.prompt: Complete the sentences.
questions.instructions: Scegli dal significato, non dalla sola espressione di tempo.
questions.learning_objective: Choose will, going to and Present Continuous from unambiguous future meanings.

content.text_template: 1. The phone is ringing — I [[blank_1]] it. 2. Look at that shelf! It [[blank_2]]. 3. Our table is booked: we [[blank_3]] at the restaurant at 8.

options: am going to answer next month

answer_error_mappings.answer: am going to answer next month

feedback.explanation: Decisione ora → will; evidenza → going to; booking + ora → arrangement.

questions.title: Make a question
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.instructions: Ask about the fixed arrangement.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Present Continuous future-arrangement question.

feedback.explanation: Where are you meeting Sofia tonight?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Ho già deciso: comprerò un computer nuovo. Domani alle quattro incontro il commesso in negozio.
questions.instructions: Usa going to per il piano e Present Continuous per l'accordo già organizzato.
questions.learning_objective: Produce be going to for a prior plan and Present Continuous for a fixed arrangement in one translation.

accepted_answers: I've already decided: I'm going to buy a new computer. I'm meeting the salesperson at the shop at four tomorrow.
I have already decided: I am going to buy a new computer. I am meeting the salesperson at the shop at four tomorrow.
I've decided: I'm going to buy a new computer. I'm meeting the shop assistant at the shop at four tomorrow.
I have decided: I am going to buy a new computer. I am meeting the shop assistant at the shop at four tomorrow.

feedback.explanation: Decisione già presa → going to buy; incontro fissato alle quattro → am meeting.

questions.title: Choose the correct sentence
questions.prompt: You can see a child carrying a huge unstable pile of books. What is the best prediction?
questions.instructions: Scegli una risposta.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise be going to for an evidence-based prediction.

options.text: He's going to drop those books.
He will to drop those books.
He going to drop those books.

feedback.explanation: La pila instabile è evidenza presente: He's going to drop...

exercises.title: Future Forms — Mini-verifica
exercises.description: Verifica se sai scegliere e costruire will, going to e Present Continuous senza suggerimenti.
exercises.instructions: Completa in autonomia. Obiettivo consigliato: almeno 80%.

questions.title: Decisione immediata
questions.prompt: A: We don't have any bread. B: Okay, ___.
questions.instructions: Scegli la risposta naturale.
questions.learning_objective: Choose will for an instant decision independently.

options.text: I'll buy some now.
I'm going to buying some now.
I buy some yesterday.

feedback.explanation: B decide in quel momento: I'll buy some.

questions.title: Previsione-opinione
questions.prompt: There is no special evidence. You simply think the new café will be popular. What do you say?
questions.instructions: Scegli la frase più naturale.
questions.learning_objective: Choose will for a prediction based on opinion rather than present evidence.

options.text: I think the new café will be popular.
Look! The café is going to be popular because a chair is falling.
I think the café will to be popular.

feedback.explanation: Qui è un'opinione/previsione: will be.

questions.title: Going to completo
questions.prompt: Correggi: We going to study together this evening.
questions.instructions: Riscrivi la frase corretta.
questions.learning_objective: Supply the correct be auxiliary in a going-to plan.

accepted_answers: We're going to study together this evening.
We are going to study together this evening.

feedback.explanation: We → are going to study.

questions.title: Previsione con evidenza
questions.prompt: A glass is rolling towards the edge of a table. What do you say?
questions.instructions: Scegli la previsione più adatta.
questions.learning_objective: Choose going to for an evidence-based prediction independently.

options.text: It's going to fall.
It will to fall.
It going to fall.

feedback.explanation: Vedi l'evidenza nel presente: it's going to fall.

questions.title: Piano o arrangement?
questions.prompt: Completa le due situazioni.
questions.instructions: Distingui intenzione generale e accordo fissato.
questions.learning_objective: Choose going to for a prior plan and Present Continuous for a fixed arrangement.

content.text_template: I've decided that I [[blank_1]] more exercise this year. My first gym session is booked: I [[blank_2]] the trainer at 7 tomorrow morning.

feedback.explanation: Exercise more = intenzione; trainer + 7 tomorrow + booking = arrangement.

questions.title: Arrangement in domanda
questions.prompt: Metti le parti nell'ordine corretto.
questions.instructions: Chiedi dell'incontro organizzato per venerdì.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Present Continuous future-arrangement question independently.

feedback.explanation: Who are you meeting on Friday?

questions.title: Decisione al momento
questions.prompt: Il telefono sta squillando. Rispondo io.
questions.instructions: Traduci rendendo la seconda frase una decisione presa adesso.
questions.learning_objective: Produce will for an instant decision in context.

accepted_answers: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
The phone's ringing. I'll answer it.
The phone is ringing. I will answer it.

feedback.explanation: La decisione di rispondere nasce nella situazione: I'll answer it.

questions.title: Ultimo controllo
questions.prompt: Seleziona tutte le frasi corrette per i significati indicati.
questions.instructions: Valuta sia forma sia funzione.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise accurate will, going-to and arrangement forms across core future meanings.

options.text: I've decided: I'm going to save more money.
We're meeting the landlord at 5 tomorrow; it's already arranged.
I'll to help you with that bag.
She going to apply for the job.

feedback.explanation: Decisione precedente → going to; accordo fissato → Present Continuous; will + base verb senza to; going to richiede be.
